mapper.select: SELECT 'TASK' AS resource_type, candidate.id AS resource_id, candidate.title, LEFT( COALESCE( NULLIF(TRIM(candidate.description), ''), CONCAT_WS(' | ', candidate.module_type, candidate.status) ), 300 ) AS summary, candidate.updated_at, CASE WHEN candidate.module_type = 'DATA_ANALYSIS' THEN CONCAT('/analysis/tasks/', candidate.id) ELSE CONCAT('/tasks/', candidate.id) END AS route FROM ( SELECT id, title, description, module_type, status, updated_at FROM task WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} ORDER BY updated_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{scanLimit} ) candidate WHERE ( candidate.title OR COALESCE(candidate.description, '') ) ORDER BY candidate.updated_at DESC, candidate.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT 'DATASET' AS resource_type, candidate.id AS resource_id, candidate.name AS title, LEFT( CONCAT_WS( ' | ', candidate.format, candidate.status, CONCAT(COALESCE(candidate.row_count, 0), ' rows'), CONCAT(COALESCE(candidate.column_count, 0), ' columns') ), 300 ) AS summary, candidate.updated_at, CONCAT('/datasets/', candidate.id) AS route FROM ( SELECT id, name, format, status, row_count, column_count, updated_at FROM dataset WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND status <> 'DELETED' ORDER BY updated_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{scanLimit} ) candidate WHERE candidate.name ORDER BY candidate.updated_at DESC, candidate.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT 'DOCUMENT' AS resource_type, candidate.id AS resource_id, candidate.name AS title, LEFT( CONCAT_WS( ' | ', candidate.media_type, candidate.parse_status, CONCAT(candidate.size_bytes, ' bytes') ), 300 ) AS summary, candidate.updated_at, CONCAT('/documents?documentId=', candidate.id) AS route FROM ( SELECT d.id, d.name, d.media_type, d.parse_status, d.size_bytes, d.updated_at FROM document d WHERE d.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM dataset ds WHERE ds.document_id = d.id ) ORDER BY d.updated_at DESC, d.id DESC LIMIT #{scanLimit} ) candidate WHERE candidate.name ORDER BY candidate.updated_at DESC, candidate.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT 'ARTIFACT' AS resource_type, candidate.id AS resource_id, candidate.title, LEFT( CONCAT_WS( ' | ', candidate.artifact_type, candidate.status, CONCAT('Task: ', candidate.task_title) ), 300 ) AS summary, candidate.updated_at, CONCAT('/artifacts/', candidate.id) AS route FROM ( SELECT a.id, a.title, a.artifact_type, a.status, a.updated_at, t.title AS task_title FROM artifact a JOIN task t ON t.id = a.task_id WHERE a.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} ORDER BY a.updated_at DESC, a.id DESC LIMIT #{scanLimit} ) candidate WHERE candidate.title OR candidate.task_title ORDER BY candidate.updated_at DESC, candidate.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT 'RUN' AS resource_type, candidate.id AS resource_id, CONCAT(candidate.task_title, ' - Run #', candidate.id) AS title, LEFT( CONCAT_WS( ' | ', candidate.status, NULLIF(candidate.current_step, ''), NULLIF(candidate.error_summary, '') ), 300 ) AS summary, candidate.updated_at, CONCAT('/runs/', candidate.id) AS route FROM ( SELECT ar.id, ar.status, ar.current_step, ar.error_summary, ar.trace_id, ar.updated_at, t.title AS task_title FROM agent_run ar JOIN task t ON t.id = ar.task_id WHERE t.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} ORDER BY ar.updated_at DESC, ar.id DESC LIMIT #{scanLimit} ) candidate WHERE candidate.task_title OR COALESCE(candidate.current_step, '') OR COALESCE(candidate.error_summary, '') OR COALESCE(candidate.trace_id, '') OR CAST(candidate.id AS CHAR) ORDER BY candidate.updated_at DESC, candidate.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
